evidence.locator: The Windows95 horizontal groove is 5x4 and thumb sheet is 11x64; the vertical groove is 4x5 and thumb sheet is 64x11. Four decoded cells yield native thumb cross sizes 16 and 16.
evidence.limits: Shared decoder; original decoding/state mapping/mask/placement not verified.

evidence.locator:
- Horizontal: `left + c + trunc((L - t - 2*c) * (value-min)/(max-min))`.
- Vertical: `top + c + trunc((L - t - 2*c) * (max-value)/(max-min))`.
evidence.claim: Conditional group2 first-byte corner intake, fixed cross geometry and horizontal/inverted vertical endpoint arithmetic with truncation after selecting the directional numerator.
evidence.limits: Initialized declared corner, decoded thumb dimensions, positive in-range native ratio and bounded arithmetic are assumptions. No historical provider/cache, decoding/device, transfer, caller range formation or whole-control proof.

evidence.locator:
| G1 | `cinf base` found; or bit 3 and `cinf base + 12` found; or bit 2 and `cinf base + 6` found | Kaleidoscope handles the message (§4.2 onward) | CDEF 3 `0x13c..0x1d2` |
| G2 | otherwise, the System file holds a non-empty `CDEF 3` | call it with the original four arguments; its result is the result; nothing else happens | CDEF 3 `0x21c..0x286` |
evidence.claim: CDEF 3 draws only when cinf base (or base + 12 with variation bit 3, base + 6 with bit 2) is found; otherwise it hands off to the System file's CDEF 3.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10). The System slider itself is Apple's (§6 item 3).

evidence.locator:
| TR3 | always | candidate ids in order: `gb + trackTier`, `gb + 1`, `base + trackTier`, `base + 1` | CDEF 3 `0xf0e..0xfa4` (h), `0xfa8..0x1038` (v) |
| TR4 | a candidate's cicn is missing, or present without a `cinf` at the same id | try the next candidate (the cicn is released) | CDEF 3 `0x2970..0x29ae`, `0x1486..0x14c8` |
evidence.claim: Track candidates gb + trackTier, gb + 1, base + trackTier, base + 1; a candidate needs both its cicn and a cinf at the same id.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10).

evidence.locator:
Cell map: **0 inactive/disabled, 1 normal, 2 pressed (hilite 129 only), 3
ghost**. Nothing reads a cell beyond 3.
evidence.claim: Thumb cell 0 for hilite 254/255, 2 for hilite 129, else 1; cell 3 is the ghost drawn only for message 13.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10).

evidence.locator:
- Horizontal: `Th.left = R.left` when `range = 0`, else
  `R.left + c + trunc((alongR − tA − 2c) · offset / range)`.
evidence.claim: Thumb along start R.left + c + trunc((alongR − tA − 2c)·offset/range), c = cinf byte 0; vertical minimum at the bottom; no inset at range 0.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10).

evidence.locator:
| SL4 | SL3, byte 2 = 0 | middle source is the single column (row) at `k` from the start | CDEF 3 `0x2b14..0x2b26`, `0x1636..0x1648` |
| SL5 | SL3, byte 2 ≠ 0 | middle source is `[S.start + k, S.end − k)` | CDEF 3 `0x2b00..0x2b10`, `0x1622..0x1632` |
evidence.claim: cinf byte 2 = 0: the track middle is the single column (row) at k, drawn as lines by the tiler; otherwise the full middle is tiled 1:1.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10).

evidence.locator: | BL1 | rect draw (caps, halves, thumb, ghost, ticks) | CopyMask `$A817` from the cicn's pixel map, through the cicn's mask with the same source rect, into the destination rect (scaled if sizes differ) | CDEF 3 `0x25cc..0x25dc` |
evidence.claim: Every rect draw (caps, halves, thumb, ghost, ticks) is a CopyMask through the cicn's own mask.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10). Pixel colour mapping into the offscreen follows QuickDraw (§6 item 8).

evidence.locator:
| OS4 | always | O3 then EraseRect of `R`: every pixel of `R` starts as the background | CDEF 3 `0xeb6..0xed0` |
| OS5 | always | the finished offscreen replaces `R` in the port (`srcCopy`, unmasked, clipped by the port) | CDEF 3 `0x13ba..0x1454` |
evidence.claim: R is erased to the background before the art, and the finished offscreen replaces R opaque.
evidence.limits: Behavioural spec verified in #400 (docs/spec/engine/slider.md); no native capture of a Kaleidoscope slider has been compared (spec §6 item 10). What the background is (selector-29 identity) is not established (§6 item 1); it is a host input.

requirements.claim: Retains every opaque pixel of the decoded selected thumb cell; no decoder/state/placement certification.

Given the declared initialized group-base cinf corner, decoded group2 thumb and explicit normalized ratio, place the thumb using the conditional CDEF3 inset, direction and truncation rule. Historical input/provider and transfer remain unknown.
Draw the slider track and thumb cell the original engine selects for each public orientation and state.
Place the slider track and thumb (travel, inset, cross-axis centring) as the original engine does.
Map public slider normal/pressed/disabled/inactive to the original control state.
Draw slider track, thumb and tick art through each cicn's own mask (CopyMask, CDEF 3 BL1) onto R erased to the background, R then replaced opaque (OS4/OS5).
Draw a pressed slider for a named part (DECISIONS #9: thumb 129, pageUp 22, pageDown 23): a page press gives pressed track art with the normal thumb cell.
Draw the directional (variation bit 2 clear or set: groups 0 and 1) and tick-mark (bit 1) sliders CDEF 3 draws, with their bands, thumbs and tick rects (§5.1, §5.4).

assertions.claim: Every decoded opaque cell pixel retained; test also checks project placement policy without claiming historical proof.
Six exact normal owned forks/environment requests with actual decoded thumb and external cinf identity, complete literal output and source/built execution. Only conditional endpoint geometry.

Source-map sentinels: every output pixel of the 144 public rows (18 archives x h/v x 4 states, length 120, value 0.25) is compared with the CDEF 3 rule table's source map; disagreements are pinned per class S1-S6 (#407), agreement is asserted for the rest. Selection, cell, placement, slicing and transfer only; no colour.
